title: OCX Profile Configuration
description: Configuration schema for OCX profile files stored at ~/.config/opencode/profiles/<name>/ocx.jsonc (OCX V2)

bin.description: Path to OpenCode binary. Falls back to OPENCODE_BIN env var, then 'opencode'.

componentPath.description: Relative path for component installation (no .. or absolute paths)

exclude.description: Glob patterns for project files to exclude from OpenCode discovery (secure by default)

include.description: Glob patterns for project files to include (overrides exclude)

renameWindow.description: Set terminal/tmux window name when launching OpenCode

serverFallback.description: Fallback when the OpenCode v2 background server is not running: standalone (inject --standalone), start (run opencode service start first, then fall back to standalone), or none (do nothing). Overridable via the OCX_SERVER_FALLBACK environment variable.
